findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "check_sevp" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_schools, get_school, list_facets, check_sevp, search_news, get_school_news, get_school_videos, list_help_organizations, get_help_organization, list_documents, get_document, check_regulation, list_events, get_test_dates, get_state_policy, get_rankings, get_network, find_schools_by_scores, get_school_views, get_headlines · Private data: compare_schools, list_help_organizations, list_documents, get_document, check_regulation, ask_usanaru, find_helpers · Public sink: get_school_videos, get_rankings, ask_usanaru, find_schools_by_scores, get_headlines, find_helpers · Destructive: get_test_dates, get_state_policy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_schools, get_school, list_facets, check_sevp, search_news, get_school_news, get_school_videos, list_help_organizations, get_help_organization, list_documents, get_document, check_regulation, list_events, get_test_dates, get_state_policy, get_rankings, get_network, find_schools_by_scores, get_school_views, get_headlines · Private data: compare_schools, list_help_organizations, list_documents, get_document, check_regulation, ask_usanaru, find_helpers · Public sink: get_school_videos, get_rankings, ask_usanaru, find_schools_by_scores, get_headlines, find_helpers · Destructive: get_test_dates, get_state_policy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
